body.prompt: Photorealistic industrial-design studio render of one palm-sized handheld digital camera, 57 mm wide, 39 mm tall, 33 mm deep. Use image[1] for the exact proportions, the 3/4 front view from slightly above and the feature layout: lens with a 16 mm ring right of centre at 41 % of the height, small square flash window upper left, round shutter button and a small slide switch on the top left above the grip, USB-C port on the right side face. Use image[2] for material, colour and the soft tube design language. Concept 'Ribbed tube': soft rounded tube bands run vertically around the left grip as deep fluted ribs, one thick tube wraps the lens as a torus ring, the rest of the block is a calm satin surface. Details: a 0.3 mm shadow-gap seam around the back edge, fine vent slots on the bottom and right side, a knurled inner ring around the lens, a tiny light-pipe dot for the charge LED on top, engraved micro icons by each port, a strap lug cast into the upper left corner. Matte light-grey 3D-printed PLA with dark-grey accents, crisp edges, clean part lines, believable to 3D print. One camera fully in frame, centered, seamless pure white background, soft neutral studio light, sharp focus, high detail. --no text, logos, screen, viewfinder hump, extra lenses, hands, people, strap
